subject: Passing values from chart point to render function

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Passing values from chart point to render function
parts:
Please bear with me as I have virtually no JS knowledge

I have a highCharts chart . In the code there is a click event

click = "#! function() { alert(this.options.country) } !#"))
 so that when a point is clicked

values such as "USA", "China" appear in the alert box

What I would like to do is pass the selected country value as input into
a renderTable function

e.g.
 output$myTable <- renderTable({
   df_sub <- subset(df_sub, country==input$country)
df_sub
})

Is this possible, and , if so, how

TIA
andrew clark
